Apply to NZ's top-ranked university

Looking to start your University journey? Apply now and take the first step towards a brighter future.

Apply now

Hiwa, Recreation Centre

Take a look at the University's state-of-the-art recreation and wellness centre. Hiwa features a pool, gym, sports courts and more.

Kōkiri Raumati Summer Programmes

Make the transition to university with confidence in 2027 by joining one of our Kōkiri Raumati | Summer Programmes.

Undergraduate study options

Thinking about university study? Discover the degree options waiting for you.

Postgraduate study options

Looking to specialise or upskill? Find your postgraduate study option.

Professional development

Discover our range of continuing education and short course options.

UoA Online

Offering a complete online learning experience. Explore our 100% online programmes and courses.

Tūhuratia | Discover

Future international students

Explore your study options, visa information, how to apply, life in Auckland and more.

Scholarships and awards

Each year we award scholarships and prizes to thousands of students just like you.

Accommodation

Whether you’re a school leaver or current student, we have a place you can call home while you study.

Find out more

Your online help and support centre. Search our frequently asked questions.

Top questions

  • How long does it take for StudyLink to process my Student Loan application?
  • How do I enrol in courses?
  • NCEA, Cambridge International, IB guaranteed entry

Application help

Join Lou, the campus Kererū, as they glide you through everything you need to know about applying to study with us.

Student Hubs

Bringing innovative and entrepreneurial potential to life.

Sustainability

The University is committed to pursuing sustainability via research, teaching and learning, operating practices, and partnerships.

Explore now

Ngā kaupapa me ngā hui | News and events

Researchers trial AI coach for diabetes

With type 2 diabetes rates rising, University of Auckland researchers are testing a digital coach designed to help people stick to healthy habits.

Summer Shakespeare back for comedy double bill

The much-loved outdoor Summer Shakespeare tradition is returning to Old Government House lawn with two comedies: Twelfth Night and A Midsummer Night's Dream.

ClockTower apprentice returns nearly 70 years after memorable mishap

An apprentice who once accidentally stopped the ClockTower clock recently revisited the landmark and shared his memories.

University events

Stay up-to-date with the wide range of events and activities happening at the University.
